content.importText:
mixed-port: 7890
allow-lan: true
mode: rule
log-level: warning
ipv6: true
unified-delay: false
tcp-concurrent: true
keep-alive-interval: 15
keep-alive-idle: 15

experimental:
  quic-go-disable-ecn: true
  quic-go-disable-gso: false

  server: time.cloudflare.com
  port: 123
  interval: 30
  dialer-proxy: ""

  listen: 127.0.0.1:1053
  ipv6: true
  enhanced-mode: fake-ip
  fake-ip-range: 198.18.0.1/16

  prefer-h3: false
  use-hosts: true
  respect-rules: false
  default-nameserver:
    - 5.175.161.3
    - 5.175.161.40
    - 45.13.237.213

    - 143.20.64.192

    - 77.88.8.8
    - 223.5.5.5

    - 83.220.169.155
    - 212.109.195.93
    - 195.133.25.16
  fake-ip-filter:
    - "*.lan"
    - "*.local"
    - "time.*.com"
    - "ntp.*.com"
    - "+.market.xiaomi.com"

rule-providers:
  discord:
    type: http
    behavior: classical
    format: yaml
    url: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/codelabhq/clash-warp-config/main/ruleset/discord.yaml
    path: ./ruleset/discord.yaml
    interval: 86400
  discord-ip:
    type: http
    behavior: classical
    format: yaml
    url: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/codelabhq/clash-warp-config/main/ruleset/discord-cidr.yaml
    path: ./ruleset/discord-cidr.yaml
    interval: 86400
  youtube:
    type: http
    behavior: classical
    format: yaml
    url: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/codelabhq/clash-warp-config/main/ruleset/youtube.yaml
    path: ./ruleset/youtube.yaml
    interval: 86400
  ai:
    type: http
    behavior: classical
    format: yaml
    url: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/codelabhq/clash-warp-config/main/ruleset/ai.yaml
    path: ./ruleset/ai_list.yaml
    interval: 86400
  meta:
    type: http
    behavior: classical
    format: yaml
    url: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/codelabhq/clash-warp-config/main/ruleset/meta.yaml
    path: ./ruleset/meta.yaml
    interval: 86400
  twitter:
    type: http
    behavior: classical
    format: yaml
    url: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/codelabhq/clash-warp-config/main/ruleset/twitter.yaml
    path: ./ruleset/twitter.yaml
    interval: 86400
  netflix:
    type: http
    behavior: classical
    format: yaml
    url: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/codelabhq/clash-warp-config/main/ruleset/netflix.yaml
    path: ./ruleset/netflix.yaml
    interval: 86400
  tiktok:
    type: http
    behavior: classical
    format: yaml
    url: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/codelabhq/clash-warp-config/main/ruleset/tiktok.yaml
    path: ./ruleset/tiktok.yaml
    interval: 86400
  torrent:
    type: http
    behavior: classical
    format: yaml
    url: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/codelabhq/clash-warp-config/main/ruleset/torrent.yaml
    path: ./ruleset/torrent.yaml
    interval: 86400
  games:
    type: http
    behavior: classical
    format: yaml
    url: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/codelabhq/clash-warp-config/main/ruleset/games.yaml
    path: ./ruleset/games.yaml
    interval: 86400
  HODCA:
    type: http
    behavior: domain
    format: text
    url: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/itdoginfo/allow-domains/refs/heads/main/Categories/hodca.lst
    path: ./ruleset/hodca.lst
    interval: 86400
  category-ru:
    type: http
    behavior: domain
    format: mrs
    url: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/hydraponique/roscomvpn-geosite/release/mihomo/category-ru.mrs
    path: ./ruleset/category-ru.mrs
    interval: 86400
  whitelist:
    type: http
    behavior: domain
    format: mrs
    url: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/hydraponique/roscomvpn-geosite/release/mihomo/whitelist.mrs
    path: ./ruleset/whitelist.mrs
    interval: 86400
  private-domains:
    type: http
    behavior: domain
    format: mrs
    url: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/hydraponique/roscomvpn-geosite/release/mihomo/private.mrs
    path: ./ruleset/geosite-private.mrs
    interval: 86400
  private-ips:
    type: http
    behavior: ipcidr
    format: mrs
    url: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/hydraponique/roscomvpn-geoip/release/mihomo/private.mrs
    path: ./ruleset/geoip-private.mrs
    interval: 2592000
  direct-ips:
    type: http
    behavior: ipcidr
    format: mrs
    url: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/hydraponique/roscomvpn-geoip/release/mihomo/direct.mrs
    path: ./ruleset/direct-ips.mrs
    interval: 86400
  ru-apps:
    type: http
    behavior: classical
    format: yaml
    url: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/codelabhq/clash-warp-config/main/ruleset/ru-apps.yaml
    path: ./ruleset/ru-apps.yaml
    interval: 86400
rules:
  - RULE-SET,private-ips,DIRECT,no-resolve
  - RULE-SET,private-domains,DIRECT
  - RULE-SET,category-ru,DIRECT
  - RULE-SET,whitelist,DIRECT
  - RULE-SET,direct-ips,DIRECT,no-resolve
  - DOMAIN-SUFFIX,telegram.org,WARP
  - DOMAIN-SUFFIX,t.me,WARP
  - DOMAIN-SUFFIX,telegram.me,WARP
  - DOMAIN-SUFFIX,telegram.dog,WARP
  - DOMAIN-SUFFIX,telegra.ph,WARP
  - DOMAIN-SUFFIX,telesco.pe,WARP
  - DOMAIN-SUFFIX,tg.dev,WARP
  - DOMAIN-SUFFIX,adserver.twitch.tv,REJECT
  - DOMAIN-SUFFIX,ads.twitch.tv,REJECT
  - DOMAIN-KEYWORD,twitch-ads,REJECT
  - DOMAIN-SUFFIX,usher.ttvnw.net,WARP
  - DOMAIN-SUFFIX,gql.twitch.tv,WARP
  - DOMAIN-SUFFIX,twitch.tv,DIRECT
  - DOMAIN-SUFFIX,ttvnw.net,DIRECT
  - DOMAIN-SUFFIX,jtvnw.net,DIRECT
  - RULE-SET,youtube,WARP
  - RULE-SET,discord,WARP
  - RULE-SET,ai,WARP
  - RULE-SET,meta,WARP
  - RULE-SET,twitter,WARP
  - RULE-SET,tiktok,WARP
  - RULE-SET,netflix,WARP
  - RULE-SET,torrent,WARP
  - RULE-SET,games,WARP
  - RULE-SET,HODCA,WARP
  - DOMAIN-SUFFIX,googleapis.com,DIRECT
  - DOMAIN-SUFFIX,gstatic.com,DIRECT
  - DOMAIN-SUFFIX,google.com,DIRECT
  - DOMAIN-KEYWORD,chrome,DIRECT
  - AND,((NETWORK,udp),(RULE-SET,discord-ip)),WARP
  - MATCH,WARP
sniffer:
  enable: true
  force-dns-mapping: true
  parse-pure-ip: true
  override-destination: false
  sniff:
    HTTP:
      ports: [80, 8080-8880]
    TLS:
      ports: [443, 8443]
